description: CR 604.2 Humility strips a Prized Unicorn's block requirement, so declining becomes legal
note: CR 604.2: a static ability works only while its permanent has it, so Humility's layer-6 LoseAllAbilities takes the Unicorn's requirement with it. Without Humility declining is refused; with it declining stands, and blocking stands too, so the combat is still live and declining became legal because the requirement went away.
